gaps.text: In-line measurement of Process temperature with temperature sensor

Each method keeps its own calibration, and the fused model must beat the best single method on held-out runs or it is dropped.)

items.finding: The source notes that the temperature sensitivity of the OH bands is a severe drawback for measuring aqueous solution in NIR and MIR, which makes tempered sample holders necessary.
items.how_it_applies: This highlights the need to closely monitor or control process temperature during NIR testing to account for OH band shifts in aqueous solutions.
items.limits_and_transfer_risks: The cited study addresses general aqueous solutions rather than an in-line flowing fermentation broth specifically.

citation.quote: Additionally, the temperature sensitivity of the OH bands is a severe drawback for measuring aqueous solution in NIR and MIR, which makes tempered sample holders necessary [29].
citation.label: E01 ¶12

items.finding: Data-level fusion involves the direct concatenation of minimally processed data from multiple modalities at the input layer to construct a unified input representation.
items.how_it_applies: This supports testing low-level data fusion by merging synchronized spectral inputs into a single augmented matrix for multivariate modeling.
items.limits_and_transfer_risks: Raw data often contain redundant or noisy signals that can degrade recognition accuracy if not properly addressed, and results from other food matrices may not transfer directly.

citation.quote: Data-level fusion is defined as the integration of raw or minimally processed data from multiple modalities at the input layer to construct a unified input representation.
citation.label: E05 ¶15
